To send a voice message:

1. Open the chat with a person you would like to send a voice message to.
2. Click the![App icon](/img/ringotel/original/cbc16026c556aa75d047/497862f9954086029f6cc518a8c0e9a61e7a04e8fcccad740c2b756b2265c5a6.png)icon at the right side of the **Message Input Area**.

![](/img/ringotel/original/7a7f8636b91aaa169b2a/714e81ea12ec2ded5a42f4afadcf3fbae9c7fd9284c993174402b12ad58fd78c.png)

1. Click the![App icon](/img/ringotel/original/4beb51e5406671873e3a/7d879ddd16d4e09a1e9eeb9896d78d356061418c3c4915acb0deb27226df50ce.png)icon at the center of the **Message Recording Panel **to start/pause the voice recording.

![](/img/ringotel/original/c34fba3ec8254a003fc3/0214496728144827bd1997a4ac68a90a37eda3c5b7e007f8bac2624dd237c243.png)

1. Click on the chat![App icon](/img/ringotel/original/206806b408c8d7a572a6/8589bdb920b0e16214181b01dbd39edae0569557f919374e846a07156be6b811.png)icon to send your voice message.

To cancel the recording of a voice message, just click on the![App icon](/img/ringotel/original/ebcd8583f70af91840fc/c60af30ce72dac962017ea4672df2735b6127b28de424d171665f7759fdb2165.png)icon at the upper-right side of the voice recording panel.
